sources.title: Core Concepts
sources.finding: Detached server owns panes, PTYs and agents; clients are disposable; named sessions are independent servers; workspace > tab > pane; agents are watched not wrapped; every UI action is a CLI command over a local socket.

sources.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration
sources.locator: concepts table, lifecycle, CLI, safety model
sources.finding: ORCH task board with ids t1.., dependencies, path leases, quality gates, merge gate into luvus/integration, worktree or shared-workspace workers, retry, context gate at 85%, events bus.

sources.title: Agent Automation
sources.locator: schedule types, misfire/overlap, access profiles, limits
sources.finding: Durable one-time/interval/daily/weekly automations (BETA) owned by the detached server; new-worker or active-agent targets; misfire and overlap policies; no automatic retry; read-only/workspace/full access mapped to native agent flags; bounds 256 definitions.

sources.title: Agents Talking to Agents
sources.locator: commands, delegation end to end, = shorthand
sources.finding: agent list/name/prompt/read/keys/start commands let one agent hand a task to another pane, wait or hand off, and read results; pane env injects LUVUS_PANE_ID and socket; optional skill.

sources.title: Working with Agents
sources.locator: AGENTS sidebar, Usage in Mission Control, session resume, fork
sources.finding: Live blocked/working/done/idle state by process and screen detection; Mission Control usage tokens and cost from agent-native stores; session resume and fork per agent; hooks add precision.

sources.title: Luvus Web
sources.locator: Start locally, pairing, control, tunnels, security model
sources.finding: luvus web starts a loopback bridge (127.0.0.1:4174) with one-use pairing links; read-only by default, --control opt-in; up to 8 devices; phone access needs a trusted TLS tunnel; stopping the bridge leaves the server running.

sources.title: Mobile Sessions
sources.finding: Narrow terminals (64 columns or fewer) get a touch-friendly single-pane layout with a Mobile Navigator; used over SSH apps such as Termius.

sources.title: Security Model
sources.locator: local control endpoint, what runs commands, Remote
sources.finding: Single-user local-trust tool; state dir 0700, sockets 0600; modules confirm declared commands; --remote rides plain ssh with no listener; "Luvus has no telemetry"; network limited to update checks and explicit installs.

sources.title: Worktrees
sources.finding: Git worktrees are first-class workspaces; creation uses built-in Git provider, optionally a module-provided worktree provider and removal command.

sources.title: The Git Tab
sources.finding: Git tab: commits, flow, branches, PRs, issues, status; PRs/issues/checks via gh CLI; in PR list c starts gh pr create; PR detail can approve or check out.

sources.title: DIFF Review
sources.locator: Open DIFF, Read the diff, Add local review notes
sources.finding: Native read-only DIFF review of staged/worktree/untracked/conflict layers with split/stack views, local notes and handoff of notes to a live agent; no stage/commit/push action.

sources.title: Multiple Machines
sources.locator: Connect your first machine, CLI setup
sources.finding: Saved SSH machine profiles place remote workspaces beside Local in one TUI; setup can install a compatible Luvus binary on the remote host with approval; luvus machine add/list/status.

sources.title: Remote Sessions
sources.finding: luvus --remote host attaches to a Luvus server on another machine over plain ssh; no public port; phone access via SSH apps or Luvus Web behind TLS.

sources.title: Universal Harness Protocol (UHP)
sources.finding: UHP 1.0 typed NDJSON method registry covering workspaces, panes, agents, orchestration, terminal, files, Git, DIFF, modules; local socket plus loopback access gateway for providers; CLI and UHP share one dispatch.

sources.title: Remote access and transport providers
sources.finding: luvus uhp access emits a loopback NDJSON gateway read-only by default with scoped, expiring control; uhp proxy runs one request over ssh.

sources.title: Installation
sources.locator: Tabs for macOS/Linux/FreeBSD, Homebrew, deb/rpm, Nix, Windows, update
sources.finding: Single static ~3 MB binary; install script, Homebrew tap, deb/rpm for x86_64 and arm64, Nix flake, Windows PowerShell installer; luvus update self-update; luvus doctor.

sources.title: Architecture
sources.finding: Server/client split; named sessions each own a server, PTY tree and orchestration ledger; single-writer event loop makes task claims and leases race-free; pure Rust single binary.
